name: test/localization.test.js

The production lineWindows and locateWhere functions must construct reachable choices, keep every request at most 255 options, recurse, and preserve unrelated answers and usage. Restoring the old unbounded window formula makes five of these tests fail. The assertions measure production request construction and traversal, not merely the scripted response.

name: test/large-rules.test.js
reason: The scripted transport isolates Jev while the real scanner, chunker, store and CLI run. Assertions cover every source range through the end of the large file, persisted incomplete status, a successful neighboring method, and CLI exit 1 rather than a clean report. Forcing production scan.status to complete makes the incomplete-scan assertions fail. The budget assertion shown by the finding observes a request built by production code.

name: createSystemOne.ask
reason: Reviewed the CI finding at the empty-batch size-error guard. The nested send helper appends every successful response; its bare return ends only that helper after both halves finish. ask merges disjoint answer IDs and sums usage, and propagates a rejected singleton instead of returning success. A four-question control verifies all four distinct answers, 40 input tokens, 8 output tokens and seven HTTP attempts. Replacing the merge with only the last response makes four token-retry regression tests fail.
